title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_cold_verify_failed}
description: Phase 8 §8.3 — emitted by maint.backup.v1 when the weekly cold-verify pass on the oldest still-retained Sunday dump fails. Paired with sec.alert.v1{kind=backup_verify_failed, severity=critical, scope=cold}. Cold-verify failures DO NOT auto-prune the affected dump (operator decides).

dump_date.description: ISO calendar date (UTC) of the Sunday dump that failed cold-verify.

error.description: Operator-readable summary of the failure (verify returned empty row-count map, decryption error, etc.).
